sites.source: recreation.gov facility 10352009 ('East Table Campground has 20 standard sites (12 are available for reservation)'), read 2026-11-20

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)') + recreation.gov ('Vault toilets are provided'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: 12 of the 20 sites are reservable in the peak season (June 5 to Sept 6 in 2026); the other 8, and every site in late May and September, are first-come.

booking.source: recreation.gov facility 10352009 ('20 standard sites (12 are available for reservation)') + rates (Peak 2026-06-05 to 09-06; First-come 05-22 to 06-04 and 09-07 to 09-27) + FS page ('a mix of reservable and first come, first served sites'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: No more than two vehicles a site; the FS page gives the second-vehicle fee as both $7 and $10. Fees run late May to late September (2026); after the fall closure the campground may be used free, with water off and toilets locked, until the gate closes in mid to late October.

fees.source: recreation.gov rates 10352009 ($20 all 2026/2027 seasons) + FS page ('Single Site: $20 per night / Additional Vehicle Fee: $7 per vehicle / ... $10 fee for extra 2nd vehicle, no more than 2 vehicles/ site'; 'can still be used for no fee when all amenities are turned off'), read 2026-11-20

note: Bridger-Teton NF campground in pines along the Wild and Scenic Snake River in Snake River Canyon, about 24 miles south of Jackson on US-26/89 (11 miles past the Hoback Junction roundabout). The trees screen the highway; there is no public river access through the campground. Popular fishing and whitewater stretch. --Claude
